body:
## Context
1. Issue #872: `plugins/adlc-pi/package.json` pins 6 `@adlc/*` dependencies with a caret (`^1.12.0`) and `@adlc/tickets` exactly (`1.12.0`). After the next release, installing an older `@adlc/pi` produces two live `@adlc/tickets` instances.
2. Issue #458: `apps/docs/public/install.sh` gates `install_gemini()` on `have agy || have jetski || return 0`, but `scripts/test/install-sh.test.mjs` only tests sandboxes with `agy` present and never tests `jetski` alone (`agy` absent).

## Changes
1. Change `"@adlc/tickets": "1.12.0"` to `"^1.12.0"` in `plugins/adlc-pi/package.json` and add a packaging test in `plugins/adlc-pi/test/packaging.test.mjs` asserting all `@adlc/*` dependencies in `plugins/adlc-pi/package.json` use consistent range prefixes (`^`).
2. Add a sandbox test in `scripts/test/install-sh.test.mjs` with `bins: ["node", "npm", "jetski"]` (no `agy`) asserting `install_gemini` proceeds and delegates to the package helper without invoking `agy` or `jetski` directly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: Every `@adlc/*` dependency in `plugins/adlc-pi/package.json` uses a consistent `^` range prefix. Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/packaging.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC2: `install_gemini` runs and delegates to the package helper when only `jetski` is on PATH (`agy` absent). Verify: `node --test scripts/test/install-sh.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: fix(adlc-pi,install): align @adlc/tickets caret range and cover jetski-only Gemini install (#872, #458)
